Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old MANUEL, dressed in a suit and holding a cane. He looks frail but determined.

MANUEL
(to the officials)
I Am Here To Receive The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live.

The officials nod and hand him a certificate. Manuel takes it, a hint of a smile on his face.

CUT TO:

INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Manuel lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He looks tired but content. Suddenly, he sits up and begins to read from a book on his nightstand.

MANUEL
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... The Theory That Claims We Are All Immortal...

As he reads, his eyes widen in shock and his face contorts in anguish.

MANUEL
(panicked)
What If It's True? What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Time?

He starts to rock back and forth, his eyes darting around the room.

MANUEL
(whispering)
I've Been Living In A Simulation... A Never-Ending Simulation... And I've Been Trapped Here For 127 Years...

He starts to laugh maniacally, his body shaking with uncontrollable sobs.

MANUEL
(whispering)
I'm Not Old... I'm Not Dead... I'm Just... Stuck...

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face, his eyes wild and his expression twisted in despair.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - LATER

Manuel lies in bed, his body still shaking with sobs. He looks up at the ceiling, his eyes filled with a mix of fear and desperation.

MANUEL
(whispering)
What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Others Like Me... Trapped In This Never-Ending Loop?

The camera zooms out, showing Manuel's small, cluttered bedroom. The walls are covered in photos and mementos, but there's something else there too... a small, cryptic message scrawled on the wall in red ink.

MANUEL
(whispering)
The Answer Lies In The Code... The Code To Escape The Simulation...

The camera lingers on the message, the words seeming to pulse with a malevolent energy.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. MANUEL'S HOUSE - DAY

Manuel is seen walking out of his house, his cane in hand. He looks determined, but there's a hint of madness in his eyes.

MANUEL
(to himself)
I Will Find The Answer... I Will Escape The Simulation...

The camera follows Manuel as he walks away from the house, the sound of his footsteps echoing through the empty streets.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
